request:
Among the production database connector classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding classes in test code (any file under a tests/ folder), which ones override get_columns with their own get_columns method that has no docstring of its own (a leading # comment is not a docstring)? Return the symbol ID of each such get_columns method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This lists the symbol IDs of get_columns methods that are defined inside production connector classes whose direct base class is SQLDatabase from the connectors base module. It traces base-class relationships to the SQLDatabase class symbol, restricts to non-test files (paths without a tests folder), and matches the method symbols that sit within each class's line range. Only methods with no docstring of their own are kept, and each qualifying symbol is returned once in symbol ID order.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.symbol_id AS symbol_id FROM code.class_bases AS cb JOIN code.symbols AS b ON cb.base_symbol_id = b.symbol_id JOIN code.symbols AS c ON cb.class_symbol_id = c.symbol_id JOIN code.files AS f ON c.file_id = f.file_id JOIN code.symbols AS m ON m.file_id = c.file_id AND m.kind = 'method' AND m.name = 'get_columns' AND m.line_start >= c.line_start AND m.line_end <= c.line_end WHERE b.file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py' AND b.name = 'SQLDatabase' AND b.kind = 'class' AND c.kind = 'class' AND f.file_id NOT LIKE '%tests/%' AND m.summary_source = 'none' ORDER BY m.symbol_id
